# 1.2.0
Player marker customization and new translations. It's recommended to refresh config files.
## Added
- Added option to change locator bar player marker style to dot, which change textures of this marker to 3 new ones. This system is currently in beta so report any bugs using GitHub Issues.
- Added config version entry to TOML and JSON config for a better update system.
- Added pl_pl translation by Fuzja Jądrowa.
- Added pt_br translation by guigiffoni.
## Changed
- Changed some entry names in config.
- Changed default player marker disappear value to inf.
